title: Board View has a column per technician plus Unassigned, counts match cards
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and "Jenny Wilson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. 3 led by Esther Howard (2 Approved, 1 Estimate), 2 led by Ralph Edwards, none for Jenny Wilson, 2 with no lead):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose the customer "ZZAUTOTEST Columns" (add it with the Add button in the customer box if it does not exist; using it keeps this test's work orders apart from others at the location) and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Columns so only this test's work orders show.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  5. Read every column header: name, avatar and number.
  6. Count the cards in each column.
  7. Open the Status filter, tick Approved only and close it.
  8. Read Esther Howard's number and count her cards again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is one column for each eligible technician (Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards, Jenny Wilson) plus an Unassigned column.
  • Each header shows the name, the avatar (photo or initials) and a number equal to its cards: Unassigned 2, Esther Howard 3, Ralph Edwards 2, Jenny Wilson 0.
  • After filtering to Approved, Esther Howard's header shows 2 and 2 cards are listed (3 - 1 Estimate = 2).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R1, S3-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), Board column header (count tooltip "N work orders"); on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “Show one Board View column per eligible technician under S2-R7, plus Unassigned.”
  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
